plugins.name: agentz-publisher
plugins.description: Guides contributors through publishing to the agentz marketplace in four phases: Analyse the idea, Research the catalog for duplicates, Build with HVE Core, and Validate with evals before opening a pull request.

skills.name: analyse-request
skills.description: Analyse what someone wants to publish to the agentz marketplace and capture it as an intent brief before anything is built. Use when someone says "I want to publish an agent", "I have an idea for a skill", "can we share this prompt with other teams", or starts the agentz publishing flow. This is phase 1 of 4 (Analyse, Research, Build, Validate). Do not use to build or edit files, or for plugins that already exist.

skills.name: build-plugin
skills.description: Build a new agentz marketplace plugin from a confirmed intent brief, scaffolding the classic plugin layout and authoring its skill, using HVE Core's hve-builder when it's installed. Use when the user says "create a plugin", "new plugin", "scaffold a skill for the marketplace", or after research-catalog returns a "new" verdict. This is phase 3 of 4 (Analyse, Research, Build, Validate). Do not use to edit an existing plugin's logic or to install plugins.

skills.name: research-catalog
skills.description: Search the agentz marketplace catalog for plugins, skills, agents and commands that already do what a new one would, and return a reuse, extend or new verdict. Use when someone asks "does agentz already have", "is there a skill for", or plans a new agent, skill or plugin. Use during research, including with rpi-research, and before hve-builder creates an artifact for agentz. This is phase 2 of 4 (Analyse, Research, Build, Validate). Do not use to build anything or to review an open pull request.

skills.name: validate-plugin
skills.description: Validate a new or changed agentz plugin before publishing by writing its Vally evals, running them, running the marketplace gate locally, and producing a publish-readiness report. Use when the user says "validate my plugin", "write evals for this skill", "is my plugin ready to publish", or after build-plugin finishes. This is phase 4 of 4 (Analyse, Research, Build, Validate). Do not use to review someone else's pull request.

agents.name: publisher
agents.description: Guides someone through publishing an agent, skill or plugin to the agentz marketplace in four phases (Analyse, Research, Build, Validate). Use when someone wants to publish or share an agent or skill with other teams. Delegates each phase to its agentz-publisher skill.

commands.name: new-plugin
commands.description: Publish a new agent, skill or plugin to the agentz marketplace (Analyse, Research, Build, Validate)

plugins.name: bicep-avm-review
plugins.description: Reviews Bicep templates against Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and organisation conventions, and produces a traceable findings report.

skills.name: bicep-avm-review
skills.description: Review Azure Bicep templates and parameter files against Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and organisation IaC conventions, and produce a findings report with evidence. Use when the user asks to "review my Bicep", "check this against AVM", "is this template production ready", "audit our IaC", or opens a PR that changes *.bicep or *.bicepparam files. Do not use for Terraform, ARM JSON authoring, or for deploying resources.

agents.name: iac-reviewer
agents.description: Read-only reviewer for infrastructure-as-code pull requests. Use when asked to review a PR or branch that changes Bicep. Delegates the review logic to the bicep-avm-review skill.

plugins.name: onboarding
plugins.description: Sets up a machine for the agentz marketplace: adds it to every installed client, installs plugins, and prepares contributors

skills.name: setup-machine
skills.description: Set up this machine to contribute plugins to the agentz marketplace. Installs agentz-publisher, HVE Core (hve-builder and vally-tests), Python with PyYAML and Vally for the evals. Use when someone wants to start contributing, has just installed onboarding, or runs /init. Do not use to install plugins for normal use, to build a plugin (use agentz-publisher) or to configure unrelated tools.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Set up this machine to contribute plugins to agentz (agentz-publisher, HVE Core, eval tooling)

plugins.name: songwriting
plugins.description: Writes and revises original English song lyrics, with structured verses, memorable choruses, natural rhyme and singability feedback.

skills.name: english-songwriting
skills.description: Write and revise original English song lyrics with titles, verses, choruses, bridges, natural rhyme and singability feedback. Use when asked to 'write an original English pop song about starting over', 'help me finish this English chorus', or 'improve the rhyme and singability of my English lyrics'. Do not use for business-email translation, programming, unrelated prose, non-English songwriting, audio generation or publishing music.

agents.name: songwriter
agents.description: Helps write and revise original English song lyrics. Use for song drafts, chorus ideas, lyric rewrites and singability feedback.
